task: Bug: the `delay_since_first_attempt` key is missing from a retrying object's `statistics` until after the first retry, so code that reads `statistics["delay_since_first_attempt"]` during the first attempt raises `KeyError`. The key should be present from the start of each run, with value `0` until a delay has occurred.
why: All four candidates make the same one-line fix in the shared `begin()`, so they differ only in their regression tests. c3's tests read `statistics` outside `with attempt:`, so on the old code a `KeyError` fails the test directly. They cover both the sync and async paths, and the comment explains why the read sits there. In c1 and c2 the read is inside `with attempt:`, which swallows the `KeyError` and treats it as a failed attempt. Those tests only catch the bug indirectly, through their `len == 2` check. c2 also adds an import. c4 (the runner-up) uses a clean `before` hook but has no async test, even though async has its own `_run_stop` path.
